description: Actifs de voirie (Base de données complète - Chaussée, Îlot, Intersection, Trottoir, Zone) is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. La base de données Voirie inclut l'inventaire des actifs de voirie (chaussées, îlots, intersections, trottoirs, bordures) avec une représentation spatiale et diverses informations attachées. Les actifs de voirie de type chaussée agrégée représentent les voies carrossables situées dans le domaine public et qui font partie du réseau routier local ou artériel. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Accotement, Autoroute, Bordure, Bretelle, Chaussée. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
